title: Bering Land Bridge base camp reveals what life was like nearly 14,000 years ago
summary_en: In a new article, Kelly Graf, professor of anthropology at the University of Kansas, highlights the research her team did excavating an early base camp in Beringia from 13,800 years ago, revealing important information about late-glacial peopling and settling-in behavior in this far northern setting.
title_cn: Bering Land Bridge base camp reveals what life was like nearly 14,000 years ago

title: Governor will speak at KU’s 50th annual Kansas Economic Policy Conference
summary_en: State lawmakers, experts and policymakers will convene at the University of Kansas for its 50th Kansas Economic Policy Conference. The 2026 event on Oct. 29 will address the “Future of the Kansas Economy,” with a talk by Kansas Gov. Laura Kelly.
title_cn: Governor will speak at KU’s 50th annual Kansas Economic Policy Conference

title: KU Law professor writes book on negotiation skills
summary_en: Stephen Ware, a University of Kansas professor of law, has written the book “Principles of Negotiation, Mediation, and Other Processes of Dispute Resolution,” a book aimed at helping law students and practitioners understand how to negotiate, the different approaches and why it’s a vital skill.
title_cn: KU Law professor writes book on negotiation skills

title: KU presentation will share story of Lawrence native, Met Opera singer Beatrice Belkin
summary_en: A University of Kansas faculty member’s Nov. 8 discussion will trace how a Jewish teenager’s early years in Lawrence led to the Met stage.
title_cn: KU presentation will share story of Lawrence native, Met Opera singer Beatrice Belkin

title: Bales Choral Society to perform with professional vocal ensemble
summary_en: The KU Bales Choral Society will join Prometheus: An American Vocal Consort for “A People United: The Human Spirit in Song” on Oct. 22 at the Lied Center of Kansas.
title_cn: Bales Choral Society to perform with professional vocal ensemble
